Legacy campaign

Renew the Grid (2022–2041)

More customers need electricity, and old oil equipment is losing its usefulness. Replace the legacy you no longer want to pass on.

Explore the Legacy campaign↗ See what’s at stake ↓

Build one utility across nine generations. This chapter is part of that journey.

Location
A fictional California utility
Starts in
2022
Generation
20 years

The situation

Your starting point

The eighth Legacy term begins in 2022 with everything earlier leaders left behind. Electricity demand rises, while oil equipment at least thirty years old loses output from 2030.

Your featured objective requires retiring oil equipment commissioned through 2000. What needs replacing depends on your own campaign history. You also need cleaner electricity, affordable bills and a manageable financial handover.

The choices

What will you do?

  1. 01

    Inspect the inherited fleet

    Find the old oil equipment that falls within the retirement objective. A long-lived asset can remain on the books after it stops being useful.

  2. 02

    Sequence retirement and replacement

    Give new capacity enough time to finish before removing old supply. Demand growth makes the replacement job larger than a simple swap.

  3. 03

    Improve what comes next

    Keep emissions, customer bills and debt in view as you renew the fleet. Your successor inherits the consequences of this round of construction.

Put your plan to the test

Decide which parts of your company's long history still belong in its future.

Open the campaign setup to begin, or continue your existing company. Later generations inherit the choices you made before them.
